dedupe_keys.name: armostafizi evacuationmodel agent based evacuation model v1 0

description: Amir Mostafizi publishes a NetLogo agent-based evacuation model first configured for near-field tsunami evacuation in Seaside, Oregon. Zenodo archives version 1.0 as Other Open, while the linked repository identifies MIT licensing and gives run instructions for NetLogo 6.0. The model combines pedestrian and vehicle movement, preparation-time and travel-speed distributions, horizontal or vertical shelters, road closures and time-varying inundation. Users provide transportation, shelter and population GIS shapefiles plus hazard CSV series, then compare clearance times or mortality assumptions under alternative routes and shelter choices. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this model. A limitation is that the Seaside calibration and 0.5 m casualty threshold are case assumptions, not transferable safety rules. Other cities need local network, hazard and behaviour data. The source archive was not downloaded, NetLogo was not run, and evacuation outcomes were not reproduced.
